headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Optional API key. Anonymous access is rate-limited to 1,000 requests/day per IP. Get a free key (same limit, usage dashboard) or upgrade to Pro/Business at https://statisticsoftheworld.com/pricing.

headerDocs.name: X-API-Key
headerDocs.description: Optional API key. Anonymous access is rate-limited to 1,000 requests/day per IP. Get a free key (same limit, usage dashboard) or upgrade to Pro/Business at https://statisticsoftheworld.com/pricing.

toolsPreview.name: get_country_overview
toolsPreview.description: Get all key statistics for a country. Returns GDP, population, life expectancy, inflation, unemployment, and more.

toolsPreview.name: get_indicator_ranking
toolsPreview.description: Rank countries by an indicator available to the caller's tier. Supports top N and bottom N queries.

toolsPreview.name: get_historical_data
toolsPreview.description: Get historical time series (20+ years) for a country and indicator pair.

toolsPreview.name: search_indicators
toolsPreview.description: Search for indicators by keyword. Use when you need to find the right indicator ID.

toolsPreview.name: get_available_indicators
toolsPreview.description: List all available indicators grouped by category.

toolsPreview.name: get_country_list
toolsPreview.description: List all 218 countries with metadata (region, income level, capital).

toolsPreview.name: get_series_data
toolsPreview.description: High-frequency (daily/weekly/monthly) series: US Treasury yield curve (UST.YC.3M … UST.YC.30Y), SOFR/EFFR/OBFR, CORRA and GoC yields, central bank policy rates for ~38 economies (BIS.CBPOL.M/D), monthly CPI inflation for ~190 countries (IMF.CPI.YOY.M, IMF.CPI.FOOD.YOY.M), monthly 10-year government bond yields for 40+ countries (OECD.IRLT.10Y), monthly unemployment (ILO.UNEMP.RT.M, EUROSTAT.UNEMP.RT.M), Eurostat HICP/industrial production/retail (EUROSTAT.*.M), monthly electricity (EMBER.ELEC.*.M), and daily shipping chokepoint transits plus weekly port trade volumes (PORTWATCH.*). Call list_series to browse. Every response carries source licence and attribution.

toolsPreview.name: list_series
toolsPreview.description: List the high-frequency series catalog (rates, yields, monthly labour and energy) with frequency, unit, source, and licence for each.

toolsPreview.name: compare_sources
toolsPreview.description: Cross-source reconciliation: for one concept (e.g. GDP), return the IMF, World Bank, and UN values side by side per country, with the year each source reports. Sources legitimately disagree — different vintages, exchange-rate conventions, and revision cycles; this tool makes the disagreement visible instead of hiding it. Works for concepts with a multi-source mapping (GDP, GDP per capita, GDP growth, population, and others).

toolsPreview.name: get_release_calendar
toolsPreview.description: Upcoming central-bank rate decisions, official data releases (GDP, trade), and IMF/World Bank meeting dates, collected from each institution's own published schedule (ECB, Bank of Canada, US BEA). Every entry carries its primary source URL.
